From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/06/Amazon_2024.svg/250px-Amazon_2024.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Amazon_2024.svg)

[Amazon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_\(company\) "Amazon (company)"), the world's largest company by revenue since 2026[\[1\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_largest_companies_by_revenue#cite_note-1)

This list comprises the world's largest companies by [consolidated](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Consolidation_\(business\) "Consolidation (business)") [revenue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revenue "Revenue"), according to the 2026 [_Fortune_ Global 500](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Global_500 "Fortune Global 500") ranking, which covers fiscal years ending on or before 31 March 2026.[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_largest_companies_by_revenue#cite_note-auto-2) Among the 50 largest companies, 26 are in the [United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States "United States"), 17 are in [Asia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asia "Asia"), and 7 are in [Europe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europe "Europe").[\[2\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_largest_companies_by_revenue#cite_note-auto-2)

This list is limited to the largest 50 companies, all of which reported annual revenues exceeding US$150 billion. This list is incomplete, as not all companies disclose their information to the media or general public.[\[3\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_largest_companies_by_revenue#cite_note-3) Data reflects each company's most recent fiscal year as reported to _Fortune_, primarily 2025.
